name: Push-up
description: Hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line; lower the chest to the floor and push back up.

name: Incline push-up
description: A push-up with the hands on a raised surface, which makes it easier.

name: Decline push-up
description: A push-up with the feet on a raised surface, which puts more load on the upper chest.

name: Barbell bench press
description: Lying on a bench, lower the bar to the mid chest and press it up until the arms are straight.

name: Incline barbell bench press
description: A bench press on a bench set to about 30 degrees, targeting the upper chest.

name: Dumbbell bench press
description: Lying on a bench, press two dumbbells up from chest level until the arms are straight.

name: Incline dumbbell press
description: A dumbbell press on a bench set to about 30 degrees, targeting the upper chest.

name: Dumbbell fly
description: Lying on a bench with the arms slightly bent, open them wide and bring the dumbbells back together above the chest.

name: Dumbbell floor press
description: Lying on the floor, press two dumbbells up until the arms are straight; the floor limits the range of motion.

name: Cable crossover
description: Standing between two high pulleys, bring the handles down and together in front of the chest.

name: Machine chest press
description: Seated, push the handles forward until the arms are straight, then return under control.

name: Pec deck fly
description: Seated, bring the two arms of the machine together in front of the chest.

name: Resistance band chest press
description: With the band anchored behind you, press both hands forward until the arms are straight.

name: Pull-up
description: Hanging from a bar with an overhand grip, pull up until the chin clears the bar.

name: Chin-up
description: Hanging from a bar with an underhand grip, pull up until the chin clears the bar.

name: Barbell bent-over row
description: Hinged forward with a flat back, pull the bar to the lower ribs and lower it under control.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
description: With one hand braced on a support and a flat back, pull a dumbbell to the hip.

name: Lat pulldown
description: Seated, pull the bar down to the upper chest and return it under control.

name: Seated cable row
description: Seated with a straight back, pull the handle to the stomach and squeeze the shoulder blades together.

name: Machine row
description: Seated with the chest against the pad, pull the handles back and squeeze the shoulder blades together.

name: Resistance band row
description: With the band anchored in front of you, pull both hands to the ribs.

name: Deadlift
description: With a flat back, lift the bar from the floor by straightening the hips and knees together.

name: Superman
description: Lying face down, lift the arms and legs off the floor and hold briefly.

name: Overhead barbell press
description: Standing, press the bar from the shoulders to straight arms overhead.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
description: Press two dumbbells from shoulder height to straight arms overhead.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
description: With the arms slightly bent, raise the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell front raise
description: Raise the dumbbells in front of you up to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell reverse fly
description: Hinged forward, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to work the rear shoulders.

name: Pike push-up
description: From an inverted V position, lower the head towards the floor and push back up.

name: Machine shoulder press
description: Seated, press the handles overhead until the arms are straight.

name: Kettlebell overhead press
description: Press a kettlebell from the shoulder to a straight arm overhead.

name: Resistance band lateral raise
description: Standing on the band, raise the hands out to the sides up to shoulder height.

name: Resistance band pull-apart
description: Holding the band in front of the chest with straight arms, pull the hands apart.

name: Cable lateral raise
description: Standing side-on to a low pulley, raise the handle out to the side up to shoulder height.

name: Face pull
description: Pull a rope from a high pulley towards the face, with the elbows high and wide.

name: Barbell curl
description: Standing, curl the bar from the thighs to the shoulders without moving the elbows.

name: Dumbbell curl
description: Curl the dumbbells to the shoulders with the palms facing up.

name: Hammer curl
description: Curl the dumbbells to the shoulders with the palms facing each other.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
description: Lying back on an incline bench, curl the dumbbells from a full stretch.

name: Cable curl
description: Facing a low pulley, curl the bar to the shoulders without moving the elbows.

name: Resistance band curl
description: Standing on the band, curl the hands to the shoulders.

name: Diamond push-up
description: A push-up with the hands close together under the chest.

name: Bench dip
description: With the hands on a bench behind you, lower the body by bending the elbows and push back up.

name: Triceps pushdown
description: Facing a high pulley, push the bar down until the arms are straight, elbows at the sides.

name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
description: Holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind the head and extend the arms.

name: Dumbbell kickback
description: Hinged forward with the upper arm still, straighten the elbow to move the dumbbell back.

name: Skull crusher
description: Lying on a bench, lower the bar towards the forehead by bending the elbows, then extend the arms.

name: Close-grip bench press
description: A bench press with the hands shoulder-width apart and the elbows close to the body.

name: Resistance band triceps extension
description: With the band anchored overhead, push the hands down until the arms are straight.

name: Bodyweight squat
description: Feet shoulder-width apart; sit back and down until the thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand up.

name: Jump squat
description: A bodyweight squat that ends with a jump, landing softly into the next repetition.

name: Wall sit
description: Hold a seated position against a wall with the thighs parallel to the floor.

name: Forward lunge
description: Step forward and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees, then push back.

name: Barbell back squat
description: With the bar across the upper back, squat until the thighs are parallel to the floor and stand up.

name: Barbell front squat
description: With the bar across the front of the shoulders, squat with an upright torso and stand up.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
description: Holding one dumbbell against the chest, squat with an upright torso.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
description: Holding a kettlebell against the chest, squat with an upright torso.

name: Dumbbell walking lunge
description: Holding dumbbells at the sides, lunge forward alternating legs as you walk.

name: Bulgarian split squat
description: With the rear foot on a bench, lower the back knee towards the floor and stand up.

name: Dumbbell step-up
description: Holding dumbbells, step up onto a bench with one leg and lower under control.

name: Resistance band squat
description: Standing on the band with the handles at the shoulders, squat and stand up.

name: Leg press
description: Seated in the machine, push the platform away until the legs are almost straight.

name: Leg extension
description: Seated, straighten the knees against the pad and lower under control.

name: Romanian deadlift
description: With the knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips to lower the bar along the legs, then stand up.

name: Good morning
description: With the bar across the upper back, hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and stand up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
description: With the knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbells along the legs.

name: Kettlebell single-leg deadlift
description: Standing on one leg, hinge forward to lower the kettlebell while the other leg extends behind.

name: Lying leg curl
description: Lying face down, curl the pad towards the glutes and lower under control.

name: Resistance band leg curl
description: Lying face down with the band around the ankles, curl the heels towards the glutes.

name: Glute bridge
description: Lying on the back with the knees bent, lift the hips until the body is straight from knees to shoulders.

name: Donkey kick
description: On all fours, lift one bent leg until the thigh is level with the back.

name: Barbell hip thrust
description: With the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips, drive the hips up to full extension.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
description: With the upper back on a bench and a dumbbell on the hips, drive the hips up to full extension.

name: Kettlebell swing
description: Hinge at the hips and drive them forward to swing the kettlebell up to chest height.

name: Cable kickback
description: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, kick the leg straight back.

name: Resistance band lateral walk
description: With a band around the legs and the knees bent, take small steps sideways.

name: Standing calf raise
description: Rise onto the toes as high as possible and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell calf raise
description: Holding dumbbells at the sides, rise onto the toes and lower slowly.

name: Seated calf raise
description: Seated with the pad on the knees, raise the heels as high as possible and lower slowly.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight line from head to heels, resting on the forearms and toes.

name: Side plank
description: Hold a straight line resting on one forearm and the side of one foot.

name: Crunch
description: Lying on the back with the knees bent, curl the shoulders off the floor.

name: Bicycle crunch
description: Lying on the back, bring each elbow towards the opposite knee in turn.

name: Lying leg raise
description: Lying on the back, raise straight legs to vertical and lower them without touching the floor.

name: Russian twist
description: Seated and leaning back with the feet off the floor, rotate the torso from side to side.

name: Mountain climber
description: From a push-up position, drive the knees towards the chest in turn at speed.

name: Dead bug
description: Lying on the back, lower the opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays on the floor.

name: Bird dog
description: On all fours, extend the opposite arm and leg and hold briefly.

name: Hanging knee raise
description: Hanging from a bar, raise the knees to hip height and lower under control.

name: Cable woodchop
description: Pull the handle diagonally across the body from a high pulley, rotating the torso.

name: Burpee
description: Drop into a push-up position, return to standing and jump.

name: Jumping jack
description: Jump the feet apart while raising the arms overhead, then return.

name: High knees
description: Run on the spot, driving the knees up to hip height.

name: Bear crawl
description: Crawl forward on hands and feet with the knees just off the floor.

name: Dumbbell thruster
description: A squat with dumbbells at the shoulders that flows into an overhead press.

name: Farmer's carry
description: Walk while holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand, standing tall.

name: Kettlebell clean and press
description: Bring the kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder in one motion, then press it overhead.

name: Turkish get-up
description: Move from lying down to standing while holding a kettlebell overhead on a straight arm.
